title: Prohibition with no grammatical actor (documented Phase 6 tradeoff)
whyThisCase: Do not 'fix' this and do not hide it. 'Shipped orders cannot be cancelled.' is a constraint, not a permission. Phase 4 does not FLAG it as undefined-actor, but QualityScoreCalculator.HasActor is false because there is no human subject and no 'the system'. The eval must still extract the sentence and print HasActor=false as a documented tradeoff — not as a detection miss, and not as a planted ambiguity to catch.

mustExtract.note: The constraint sentence must exist as a requirement unit.

actorChecks.note: Expected HasActor=false. Same limitation as 'The reports should be managed properly.' See the comment on HasActor in QualityScoreCalculator.
